device_name.description: Name of the evdev input device to remap

phys.description: Optional phys path to disambiguate multiple devices with the same name

dual_role.description: List of dual-role key configurations; processed before remap rules. Holding produces one key, tapping produces another.

remap.description: List of one-shot key remappings; processed in order after dual-role rules.

dual_role_items.description: Schema for items in dual_role list; each item defines dual-role behavior for one input key

dual_role_items_hold.description: Keys emitted when the key is held down

dual_role_items_tap.description: Keys emitted when the key is tapped (pressed and released quickly)

remap_items.description: Schema for items in remap list; each item maps a sequence of input keys to output keys

remap_items_output.description: Keys to emit when the input sequence is matched
